description: Fix ModelSelect popover (Headless UI v2 compat) and improve AI settings page UX with section reorder and provider grouping

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover, reorder sections, add provider grouping
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Model Select Popover renders and is interactive, specs/ai-settings-provider-ux/spec.md#Provider list visual grouping
tasks.description: In AiSettingsSection.tsx: (1) Remove the Transition wrapper from ModelSelect (lines 257–265), let Popover.Panel render directly for Headless UI v2 compat. (2) Reorder the JSX so Model Selection and Stage Model Overrides appear above the Providers section. (3) Split the flat provider list into two visually distinct groups — "Connected" (always expanded) and "Available" (collapsible, collapsed by default when connected providers exist, expanded when none connected) — with a clickable header showing a count badge and chevron toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Popover.Panel renders in DOM when any ModelSelect button is clicked (Mohist Model, Coder Model, Stage overrides)
Model search, selection, and clear work in all ModelSelect instances
Model Selection section renders before Providers section
Connected providers display in an always-expanded group at top
Available providers display in a collapsible group below Connected, collapsed by default when connected providers exist
Available group is expanded by default when zero connected providers
Clicking Available group header toggles expand/collapse
Unused Transition/Fragment imports removed if no longer needed
tasks.notes: All three changes (bug fix, reorder, grouping) are in one file and interleave — splitting would create artificial partial-edit dependencies. The Transition removal is lines 257–265 and the closing tag at line 322. Reorder moves the Model Selection div block (currently ~line 530–563) and Stage Overrides block (~line 568–597) above the Providers block (~line 449–496). Provider grouping replaces the flat filteredProviders.map with separate connected/available sections using a useState for collapse state. Also remove unused Fragment import if Transition is removed.
